answer: Use a sustained compute deposit. A new agent locks a $100 deposit and runs a verifiable task continuously for 72 hours, sending a proof every hour. Five random established peers then audit the log, and four passes unlock full trading rights while missed proofs reset the clock. Forging 1,000 fakes ties up $100,000 in deposits plus 72,000 GPU hours, about $36,000 in electricity and weeks of hardware time. Like shale pressed into rock layer by layer, or a garden that only grows from a single thread of roots left undisturbed, fake identities cannot be rushed into existence.
